notes: Added required stories for EVAL-CT-M1 covering schema, logic, API exposure, tests, and integration.

change_log.note: Schema/contract definition for trial phase scoring

EVAL-CT-M1-S1.title: Define Trial Phase Scoring Schema and Contract
EVAL-CT-M1-S1.description: Define a normalized schema for representing clinical trial phase (I, II, III, IV) and its mapped score contribution, including handling of missing or non-standard phase labels from ClinicalTrials.gov.

EVAL-CT-M1-S2.title: Implement Trial Phase Scoring Logic
EVAL-CT-M1-S2.description: Implement backend logic to map trial phases (I-IV) to a maturity score, including normalization of raw API values and deterministic scoring rules.

EVAL-CT-M1-S3.title: Expose Trial Phase Score via Evaluate Care Facade
EVAL-CT-M1-S3.description: Integrate phase scoring into the evaluate_care_facade so that each clinical trial result includes a phase-based score signal in the response payload.

EVAL-CT-M1-S4.title: Unit Tests for Trial Phase Scoring Logic
EVAL-CT-M1-S4.description: Create unit tests validating phase normalization and scoring across all phase values, including edge cases such as missing or malformed phase data.

EVAL-CT-M1-S5.title: Integrate Phase Scoring into Clinical Trials Service Pipeline
EVAL-CT-M1-S5.description: Embed phase scoring into the clinical trials retrieval pipeline so that scoring occurs during data transformation after API fetch and before response assembly.
